info.title: Cyberwave development extensions
info.description: Development endpoints and workflow pagination overrides; deployment availability must be checked separately.

get.description: List all workflows visible to the authenticated user (respects ACL).

Typed editable defaults from the existing template metadata and node registry.

Permission flags are hints, not authorization: mutations recheck ACLs and
runtime preconditions. Dynamic bindings are deliberately excluded.
List all executions for a workflow.

Return the canonical catalog of playground ``structured_task`` values.

Serves as the machine-readable doc consumed by the Python SDK and the
frontend so everyone shares one source of truth for action ids, default
prompts, and output schemas. See
``src.lib.structured_actions`` for the authoring surface.

post.description:
Atomically import metadata; repeat the same external_id and body to retry.

Changes require a new campaign external_id. Existing source observations and
review revisions are never overwritten by an import.
Append a review using optimistic concurrency; retries return the same revision.

get.description:
Discover definitions assigned to visible twins currently in an environment.

This is a read projection, not a new mission owner or a multi-environment plan.
Executions (including scheduled runs) remain nested under each mission.
Workspace governance view, scoped to the target twin and caller's access.

WorkflowExecutionPendingReasonSchema.description:
Why a ``requested`` edge execution has not started yet.

``None`` on any row that is not waiting on an edge worker.
